用法：captae download <链接> [--audio] [--for:
Usage: captae download <url> [--audio] [--format MP4] [--resolution 1080p] [--preset name] [--out dir] [--items 1,3|all] [--json]
       captae download <url> --record-live [--max-minutes N] [--out dir] [--json]
       captae download <url> --sample <MB> [--out dir] [--header 'Name: value'] [--json]

--record-live: if the stream is live, record from now on. --max-minutes N: record at most N minutes (decimals are OK), then stop and save automatically;
without it, recording goes on until you press Ctrl-C once to stop and save (what was recorded becomes a playable file in your library). Press it again to quit right away
下载其中几个：captae download {url} --items 1,2: To download some of them: captae download {url} --items 1,2 (or --items all)

--sample 后面写要下多少 MB，比如 --sample 5: --sample needs the number of MB to download, for example --sample 5
--max-minutes 要和 --record-live 一起用（录直播时最: --max-minutes only works with --record-live (the most minutes to record a live stream)
--max-minutes 后面写分钟数，比如 --max-minutes 30: --max-minutes needs a number of minutes, for example --max-minutes 30
--max-minutes 后面写大于 0 的分钟数，比如 --max-minu: --max-minutes needs a number of minutes greater than 0, for example --max-minutes 30 (decimals are OK)

Captae {version}

  captae mcp --stdio

  captae probe <url> [--json]

  captae engine [--health] [--json]
  captae query [keywords]
  captae status

Exit codes: 0 success, 1 failed, 2 wrong usage, 3 choose items (playlist, multi-video post)
